from collections import defaultdict
color_groups = defaultdict(list)
for r, c, val in nonzero_positions:
    color_groups[val].append((r, c))

for color, positions in sorted(color_groups.items()):
    print(f"Color {color}: {positions} -> {len(positions)} pixels")
